description: List the names of the custom fields your contacts carry, A to Z with case ignored, up to 200 (`more` says there are others). A name is what a merge field reads: `{{ industry }}`, or `{{ contact["Company size"] }}` when it has a space or a dash. The standard fields (first_name, last_name, company, phone, email) are not listed.
name: list_contact_custom_fields
title: List custom field names
